title: RFC 3339 Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps

Example.how: each thing RFC 3339 section 5.8 tells of its own examples (an example in UTC, the example it calls equivalent to a date-time in UTC, the two it calls the same leap second) is an acceptance vector of the rfc3339 guest (app/specs/rfc3339/spec.json, written by generators/senses rfc3339cases from the pinned text), which reads a date-time by the RFC's section 5.6 grammar and section 5.7 restrictions and tells its instant in UTC; GU-01 replays the pinned wasm over the vectors
